description: From the sand, the great stone arches of Playa de las Catedrales rise in the moonlight — the natural buttresses and vaults of the cliffs standing like a Gothic nave while clouds drift across the moon. The arches catch silver light on their edges, with the sea washing dark at their feet. At low tide this beach is a cathedral of rock; by night, under a veiled moon, it's pure drama.
